finding: At fixed supplied warm start, history, input and budget, the new medium adapter did not improve final developer quality. Denoising pool-best RMSE was worse in both reversed-order repeats; Aerial had mixed near-ceiling differences.
decision: Close this predeclared test without expanding the checkpoint, replacing seeds, pooling to rescue the gate, or changing its reader. Continue only source/configuration clarification under the current request.
limits: Two paired pool repeats within one service/allocation; not 32 independent replicates.
Only two reused developer tasks and supplied warm programs; not held-out generalization.
Adapter training revision, costs and overlap remain unconfirmed; not a general refutation of policy training.
No fast baseline in this batch; it does not establish comparisons with the strongest search recipe.
Training-credit hypotheses are not explanations proven by this result.
